viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: Reviewed public official Abia property-service pages and the Ministry of Lands & Housing service listing. The state property workflow is an application interface, not an anonymous public map; registration steps ask for property/land references and identity/title documents. GIS mapping/survey is provided on request after submission of a survey plan and proof of ownership. No coordinates, owner records or private application endpoints were queried. No public parcel geometry route or viewer JavaScript was exposed by the reviewed pages.
